title: Little Fish: Pope Guilty the First
content:
Dan finally learns the truth about a playground rumour, while he, Anna and James discuss YOUR facts . This week's subjects include naughty Newfoundlanders, olive oil, and pointing at pumpkins. And the gang announce eight more Friend of the Podcast custodians.

Visit nosuchthingasafish.com for news about live shows, merchandise and more episodes.

Edited by James Harkin

Produced by Leying Lee

Team includes Tara Dorrell, Joe Mayo and Ethan Ruparelia
